items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: Well then, maybe it was Malts that brought him back to New York. Quite likely it was.

ctx.x: I think we're mostly from September on...
Well then, maybe it was Malts that brought him back to New York. Quite likely it was. For that whole period, that probably began that whole period.
He never wanted to fly. He always refused to fly.
